senses.gloss: ढ tad. affix ढ (1) applied to the word सभा in the sense of 'fit for' ( तत्र साधुः ) in Vedic literature;. e. g. सभेयः; cf. IV. 4.106; (2) applied to the word शिला in the sense of इव; e. g. शिलेयं दधि ; cf. P. V. 3.102; (3) common term ( ढ ) for the affixes ढक्, ढञ् and ढ also, after the application of which the affix ङीप् (ई) is , added in the sense of feminine gender; cf. P. IV. 1.15.
